Density.$Comment: NATURAL ROLLING TERRAIN (1C): the two flat-core Cylinder masks (r70) are REMOVED so hills + caves apply across the whole footprint; only the r112 edge-cliff Cylinder remains (the finite-world boundary the design keeps). All-additive + fail-safe: any optional term degrading to ConstantValueDensity(0.0) just drops that feature; no top-level Min/Max, so the ground never airs out. Sign law: density >0 SOLID, <=0 (incl 0.0) AIR; surface = zero-crossing. HAND-TRACE (any x,z): density = wideRamp(y) + hillNoise(x,z) + caveCarve + edgeCliff. wideRamp = CurveMapper[In:-40->1, In:40->-1] over (y-80), slope -0.025/blk, crosses 0 at y=80 (top-solid y=79, stand y=80), clamps to +1 below y=40 and -1 above y=120. hillNoise in [-0.20,+0.20] shifts the zero-crossing by noise/slope = +-8 blocks, so the surface rolls between ~y=72 (valley) and ~y=88 (hilltop). +-0.20 << the ramp's 1.0 clamp so density stays negative above the surface (NO solid-to-sky flood) and positive below (no floating gaps). Caves carve only y<66 (depthMask) where |noise3D|<0.15 (pocketMask), 6+ blocks below the lowest valley surface so they never breach the walkable floor. Beyond r112 the edge term adds -100000 = sheer cliff into the void. EXPECTED SURFACE Y RANGE: ~72..88 across the footprint (mean 80).

Inputs.$Comment: Hill noise applied EVERYWHERE except a SMALL r6 spawn clearing (the ruined courtyard) so the player spawns on flat, deterministic ground at y80 matching instance SpawnPoint.Y - this is a tiny clearing, NOT a wide flat disc. The Cylinder is 0 inside r6 and ramps to full hills by r12 (smooth courtyard edge); origin-centered, which is exactly where spawn is. +-0.20 amplitude -> +-8 block hills under the -0.025/blk ramp slope; well under the ramp's 1.0 clamp so no solid-to-sky flood. A Multiplier degrading to 0 -> flat ground, never an air-out.

EDGE CLIFF (finite-world boundary): 0 inside r112, -100000 beyond (sheer cliff into the void). There is no procedural cave-noise term here (a Multiplier carving |noise3D|<0.15 air pockets below y66) and adding one is not worth it: it hollows pockets nobody interacts with and generates with no lower depth bound; the descend-and-return cave SHRINES are unaffected (the runtime Relight_Shaft + the worldgen KN_ShrineDungeon force-carve their own space). See the ISLAND FLOOR term below for the finite-slab bottom.

ISLAND FLOOR (shorter island): the VERTICAL analogue of the r112 edge-cliff term. Over BaseHeight 'Base' Distance:true (= y-80) it contributes 0 at/above y~36 (In>=-44) and -100000 below it (In<=-50), carving a flat UNDERSIDE so the grove is a FINITE slab (rolling surface ~y72-88 down to ~y36) floating over the void, NOT a solid column to bedrock. floorY ~36 stays below the deepest kept underground feature (runtime cave chambers ~y65, worldgen KN_ShrineDungeon descent ~y44). All-additive + fail-safe like the rest of the Sum. Tunable: raise both In points together to thin the slab once/if the deep dungeon is dropped.

Props.$Comment: TREE COLLISION FIX (Runtime 2): trees run in the LAST prop runtime, AFTER every structure (big shrines at Runtime 0, small shrines at Runtime 1). PropStage copies the previous runtime's material output as this runtime's input, so a Runtime-2 tree READS all placed crypts/dungeons/houses/ruins; its Floor pattern (Soil_Grass_Dry under Empty) then FAILS on a structure footprint (now rock/brick) and the tree skips it, instead of growing through the building. Trees still place normally on open grass. 1C: ambient blight trees scattered by WORLDGEN (replaces the runtime ArenaBuilder foliage ring, per the design's 'trees from worldgen, not manual paste'). A sparse jittered SquareGrid2d (Scaler 16, Jitter2d Magnitude 0.5 of a cell) of weighted native dead/poisoned tree prefabs (FULL ATMOSPHERIC PASS: ash/poisoned/petrified/burnt-dead stages plus rare Ash_twisted Large/Giant canopy landmarks; density unchanged, only the variety widened - all paths verified to resolve to native prefab folders), floor-snapped to the rolling surface by the Locator's Linear scanner (Base -20 to +40, top down, first match) and turned a random quarter-turn by the RandomRotator. A malformed Prefab prop fails the WHOLE biome decode (= all air), so this follows the vanilla Example_Prop 'Hills' shape (Assigned over Positions, then Locator, RandomRotator, Prefab). Validate in-game (the biome JSON is not gradle-compiled).

TRACK A (cycle 3): SPARSE corrupted-structure ruins scattered gen-time among the dead trees. CLONED from Props[0] (the Type:Prefab tree-scatter prop) and repointed at the committed KweebecNightmare/Corrupted_* structures, so it mirrors the proven Prefab-prop shape exactly (a malformed Prefab prop fails the WHOLE biome decode = all air; validate in-game, this JSON is not gradle-compiled). MUCH sparser than the trees: grid Scale 48 (vs the trees' 16) plus SkipChance 0.85 means only a handful of ruins land, biased to the outer grove since the structures are big (the small Lamppost / House / Bridge are weighted highest, the large Shop / GuardTower / Well rarest). A Prefab prop places every entity baked into its prefab, so the Corrupted_* files must stay free of the source villages' NPC_Spawn_Marker / NPC_Path_Marker entities (they carry none). Placement guard: the Locator's Linear scanner floor-snaps onto the rolling surface and the Floor pattern only accepts a column standing on Soil_Grass_Dry under Empty, so a ruin never gouges existing soil or floats in the air; we DROP the trees' +8 air-offset headroom check because these structures are tall and do not need clear sky at exactly +8 blocks. RandomRotator turns each ruin. Jitter2d Magnitude 0.5 (half a cell). NOTE: each Path names a loose file without its .prefab.json extension, which loads nothing, so this prop places no ruins until the paths spell it (KweebecNightmare/Corrupted_Lamppost.prefab.json). IN-GAME GATE once they resolve: confirm the footprints do not bury/float badly on rolling terrain or cut into a shrine.

Runtime 2 (same as trees) so debris reads ALL placed structures (big shrines at Runtime 0, small shrines at Runtime 1) and its Floor pattern skips their footprints instead of landing logs on/through the crypts + houses. FULL ATMOSPHERIC PASS: forest-floor DEBRIS - fallen logs, stumps, petrified logs, mossy boulders strewn through the dead grove for cover + decay texture. CLONED from the Corrupted_* ruins prop (the proven Type:Prefab scatter shape; a malformed Prefab prop fails the WHOLE biome decode = all air), repointed at verified native prefab folders (each folder resolves to a random child variant). Sparser than trees (grid Scale 14 + SkipChance 0.7). The prefabs carry no entities; the Floor pattern + the Locator's Linear scanner floor-snap each piece onto Soil_Grass_Dry under Empty so nothing gouges soil or floats; RandomRotator turns each piece. Validate in-game (this JSON is not gradle-compiled).

FULL ATMOSPHERIC PASS: rare GRAVES + RELICS - Cursed Crypt tombstones + a warning sign-post seeded sparsely as haunted set-dressing. The big Crypt_Entrance set-piece is deliberately NOT scattered here (it carves a deep pit; a random drop onto a shrine/spawn would break the chase) - that stays on the runtime, ExclusionMask-protected seam. CLONED from the ruins prop shape. Very sparse (grid Scale 40 + SkipChance 0.85). The prefabs carry no entities; Floor pattern + Linear scanner floor-snap; RandomRotator turns each piece. Validate in-game.

ATMOSPHERE CLUSTERS (composed multi-prefab set-dressing): each cluster is a Union of native debris prefabs at fixed offsets from the anchor, the same layout the KweebecNightmare/Cluster_Deadfall and Cluster_Rubble prefabs encode as Prefab_Spawner_Block children (Deadfall, weight 3: Cedar_Logs/Large at 0,0,0, Fir_Logs/Small at 2,0,1, Autumn_Stumps at -2,0,1; Rubble, weight 2: Petrified_Logs at 0,0,0, Cedar_Logs/Small at 2,0,-1, Autumn_Stumps at -1,0,2). The layout is spelled out here because this generator's Prefab prop resolves a child's PrefabPath as a folder path, and those prefabs write theirs in dot notation (Trees.Cedar_Logs.Large.*), which it cannot resolve, leaving the bare @Tech spawner blocks standing; change both places together. SPARSER than the lone-debris pass (grid Scale 40 + SkipChance 0.8) so a handful of intentional rubble/deadfall piles read among the single debris. The prefabs carry no entities; Floor pattern + the Locator's Linear scanner floor-snap the cluster anchor, RandomRotator turns the whole cluster, and the side pieces sit at the anchor's height, so on a slope one can float or sink a block. IN-GAME GATE: the biome still generates (not all-air) and the clusters appear as grouped debris. This JSON is not gradle-compiled.

WORLDGEN SHRINE HOSTS - SMALL CRYPTS (scatter, Runtime 1): the furnace-baked copied-vanilla Tomb_Small crypts (Shrine_Crypt_01/02), scattered via the same jittered SquareGrid2d + Weighted shape the trees and debris use. SPAWN-ORDER: the big landmark hosts (the large crypt + the underground dungeon) place FIRST at Runtime 0; these small crypts run at Runtime 1 so they READ those placed footprints (now rock/brick) and their Floor pattern (Soil_Grass_Dry under Empty) SKIPS them, filling in AROUND the landmarks instead of crowding or overlapping them. Density slightly REDUCED (SkipChance 0.6, was 0.5) to leave room for the bigger hosts. Scatter is best-effort now (a Prefab prop places every baked entity, so each host spawns its baked hidden shrine MARKER entity): ShrinePlacement force-loads the play core, queries the markers to learn the real count + positions, and runtime-tops-up only the MISSING ones (spaced) to guarantee >=ArenaLayout.SURFACE_WORLDGEN_SHRINES; the furnace is discovered via its interaction. Furnace is a baked 4-cell multiblock (renders correct). IN-GAME GATE: confirm hosts generate, the marker is detected, the round is winnable, and the biome is not all-air (a malformed Prefab prop airs out the whole biome). Not gradle-compiled.

WORLDGEN SHRINE HOSTS - LARGE CRYPT (scatter, Runtime 0): the big furnace-baked Shrine_Crypt_Large, scattered (Scale 72 + SkipChance 0.72, ~2 per round) on its own prop. SPAWN-ORDER: runs at Runtime 0, BEFORE the small crypts (Runtime 1), so this big ~29x29 landmark claims its ground first and the frequent small crypts skip its footprint instead of crowding it. The dense grid and low SkipChance keep the landmark RELIABLY present on every map; raise Scale or SkipChance and it starts skipping whole maps. Same proven Prefab-prop shape; a Prefab prop places every baked entity, so the hidden shrine MARKER entity spawns with it (ShrinePlacement queries it to detect this host + top up any missing shrines); Floor pattern + the Locator's Linear scanner floor-snap it onto Soil_Grass_Dry under Empty. A landmark shrine. IN-GAME GATE: confirm it floor-snaps without burying/floating on rolling terrain, and the marker is detected. Not gradle-compiled.

WORLDGEN SHRINE HOST - UNDERGROUND DUNGEON (scatter + CARVE, Runtime 0): the furnace-baked multi-level descent Shrine_Dungeon_Underground_01, scattered (Scale 80 + SkipChance 0.78, ~1-2 per round - a denser grid + lower skip than a 90/0.7 pairing, which too often rolls zero) on its own prop because it is a big deep carve. SPAWN-ORDER: runs at Runtime 0 alongside the large crypt (BEFORE the small crypts at Runtime 1), a big landmark host placed first. UNLIKE the surface crypts this prefab DESCENDS: its anchor IS the surface ENTRANCE (anchorY 36) and the body extends DOWN ~36 blocks to the furnace chamber, the descent shaft authored as Empty cells. A Type:Prefab worldgen prop writes EVERY stored cell incl. Empty (source-verified: props.PrefabProp.generate -> materialWriteSpace.set(material, pos) per cell, no air skip), so the Empty cells CARVE the descent straight out of the solid grove AT GENERATION TIME - the same carve the runtime cave-shaft seam did, now gen-time and reliable (no worldgen race, no force-paste). The Floor pattern + the Locator's Linear scanner land the ENTRANCE flush on Soil_Grass_Dry under Empty; the body carves below into the dirt/rock (material runs to BottomY -80, far below the ~surface-36 chamber). The Prefab prop spawns every baked entity, so the hidden kn_shrine_marker entity spawns with it (worldgen tags it FromWorldGen so ShrinePlacement detects it, tops up, and clusters surface Moonbloom at the entrance) and the dungeon self-bakes its own Moonbloom supply down the shaft. Furnace is a baked 4-cell multiblock, discovered via its interaction like every other host. RandomRotator spins the footprint. IN-GAME GATE: confirm the entrance carves flush (not buried/floating) on rolling terrain, the descent is walkable to the furnace, the marker is detected, and the biome is not all-air (a malformed Prefab prop airs out the WHOLE biome). Not gradle-compiled.

WORLDGEN SHRINE HOSTS - CORRUPTED HOUSES (scatter): the two furnace-baked copied-vanilla Kweebec medium houses (Shrine_House_01/02), scattered RARELY (Scale 80 + SkipChance 0.6) on their own prop so their tall ~25x33 footprint stays sparse.
